[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43905407/889c98d3275ac8323221442eea228d1ae26d43c5.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]To mark World Suicide Prevention Day, Fireside Feelings is proud to take part in Games Against Living Miserably 2025.[/h2][p]
Games are great. We all know that. But did you know they can also be great for your head?

Running from [b]September 8th to 15th[/b], we are taking part in Games Against Living Miserably 2025 - the event on Steam that celebrates how games can help us unwind, connect, and escape.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="buDprkaYtog;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It’s presented by [b]Curve Games[/b] and the suicide prevention charity, [b]Campaign Against Living Miserably[/b].
By taking part, [b]we’ve pledged a donation to CALM’s life-saving work[/b].
[/p][h3]Why your support matters[/h3][list][*][p]1 in 4 of us will have suicidal thoughts.[/p][/*][*][p]125 people die by suicide every week.[/p][/*][*][p]Someone attempts suicide every 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Suicide is the biggest killer of men under 50.[/p][/*][*][p]Suicide is the leading cause of death for people aged 15-39.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]So, grab a game (or two) and play your part against suicide.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/GALM25"]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/GALM25[/url][/p][p][/p][p]🍵 Follow [i]ZeNfA Productions [/i]on social media:[/p][p][url="https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@ZeNfA"]Mastodon[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/zenfaproductions.com"]Bluesky[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.threads.com/@zenfagames"]Threads[/url][/p]

notes.title: WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43905407/3118fdaccd7dcb419b6a79cf96e333c83c11d248.png[/img]

[h2]WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale [/h2]

We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day!

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, and you can save a fin-tastic 60% off Rocket and 70% off Drop It: Block Paradise. We will also donate 50% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.*

[h2]Who are WDC?[/h2]

WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation are the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear, pollution, captivity and hunting and whaling. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.

Their mission is to reverse the global decline of whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic beings. And their vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.

[h2]What is ghost gear?[/h2]

Ghost gear is fishing gear that has been lost or abandoned at sea. It’s a deadly menace to whales, dolphins and other marine life. 

When a whale or dolphin gets tangled in it, it can kill them in the most horrific way, by preventing them from getting to the surface to breathe. Or they can carry it for days, weeks or even months suffering a slow and painful death as it cuts into their skin, restricts their movement and hampers their ability to hunt and feed. 

But it’s difficult and expensive for fishers and other ocean users to dispose of gear they find at sea, or even to responsibly get rid of their own gear at the end of its life.

Did you know that about 1/3 of marine litter found in European seas is discarded fishing gear? That's estimated to be over 11,000 tonnes entering the sea each year!

It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  

[h2]How your support will help this year[/h2]

By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue their global conservation work, as well as their ghost gear removal project, funding 10 missions for divers to remove lethal entanglement hazards to marine life (and scuba divers) from reefs, seabed and shipwrecks in UK seas.

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring, intelligent beings. The ocean produces more oxygen and absorbs more carbon than all of Earth's forests combined, and whales help it flourish. Yet 300,000 whales die in fishing gear every year. 

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: [url=https://whales.org/ ]https://whales.org/ [/url]

Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does by signing up to their mailing list here: [url=https://games.whales.org/#newsletter]https://games.whales.org/#newsletter[/url]

And you can find many other amazing games in the sale here: [url=https://bit.ly/WODSale25]https://bit.ly/WODSale25[/url]

Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC!

[i]*50% of our net revenue from this sale (after Steam platform fees) will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. WDC is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).[/i]

The issue involving Controllers not always working has now been fixed. Occasionally when starting up the game it would not recognize the controller, but it would if you turned it on after you launched the game. If you are still having issues, please make sure that Steam Input is not turned on.

notes.title: The Full Release Update - Version 2.0.0
notes.notes:
The Full Release, Version 2.0.0 is now available, this includes the following changes:

[list]
[*]New Game Mode: Void - Find the special portal to advance to the next level. As you search, take on various hazards of each level.
[*]New Weapon Types: Ray Blaster & Ray Bomb. Both giving you laser powers!
[*]Bunch of new Upgrades: Try out various new Upgrades, as well as previous upgrades got buffed and numbers increased.
[*]Super Slots: Unlocked all 24 Ship Slots? Check out the Super Slots, these advanced mechanics will supercharge any upgrade you place on them. For example, got 5 Power upgrades? Place 1 Power upgrade here to fully apply all 5 at once, allowing you to free up precious normal Ship Slots for different upgrades. This will change the way you play the game!
[*]7 new Achievements, bringing the new total to 34.
[/list]

[h3]Rocket! - Now Fully Released[/h3]
With this latest release, Rocket is now finished and feature complete. Containing 7 different arcade game modes, 4 main weapon types (9 main weapons & 7 bombs), various ship upgrades to try out and more to try out in 1 single game. I am looking forward to the various scores players are able to achieve in the various game modes!

[h3]Final Price Increase[/h3]
With this latest addition to the game, Rocket will receive its 3rd and final price increase as part of exiting Early Access. On September 14th, 2024 Rocket will increase by $2.00 USD from $7.99 to $9.99.

If you have any suggestions, bugs or issues - feel free to reach out via the Steam Forums or on [url=https://discord.gg/vPSj9yYUa4]Discord[/url].

notes.notes:
The next big update for Rocket is now here! With version 1.3.0, you can find a brand new game mode called Survive - a challenging mode where you start out with limited rockets & health points and must do whatever you can to survive. Each new level will give you an upgrade choose, so choose wisely. This new update adds a whole bunch of new additions and changes to the game:

[list]
[*]Survive Game Mode.
[*]The Wild Open - A open sandbox environment to play around in outside of the five main game modes.
[*]New Weapons & Upgrades: Twirling Blades, Helix Rockets, Slowdown Bomb and more!
[*]A new fun unlockable visual mode - Radar, where everything gives you a new look on the game.
[*]6 brand new Achievements (21 in total now)
[*]4 new Ship Slots (24 in total) - Use these upgrade slots wisely.
[*]Various improvements and enhancements
[/list]

[h2]The Wild Open[/h2]

Introducing The Wild Open. This is a sandbox open world area of Rocket outside of the main 5 game modes where you can adventure off in any direction and explore. As you venture out on your own, you will find many different events to explore, enemies to defeat and various resources to collect. This will actually be the focus of future updates for the game. Currently it's more like a fun sandbox environment where you can goof off and have fun. But in the future I plan to add some adventure purposes to it with more things to do.

[h2]Adventure Mode Update - B.O.G. Update[/h2]

Launching sometime in the Summer, will be a fun addition to the game that adds a B.O.G. (Buddy Object Gadget). This is a fun helper bot that you can find in The Wild Open that you will be able to take care of and evolve it into a powerful asset. Depending on how you feed it resources, will determine what it evolves into and what kind of abilities it might take on. You will be able to take these helpful bots into the various game modes (even Arcade & Survive) and score even higher and higher than before!

[h2]Adventure Mode Update - Portal Question Update[/h2]

Launching sometime in the Fall, will be a big Adventure Update to The Wild Open that adds a fun main questline to establish various portals throughout the universe. The reward for doing so will give you access to Super Slots for your Ship Upgrades. Unlike you normal Ship Slots, an Upgrade applied here will automatically apply all purchased upgrades at once. This ability will become quite useful if you wish to reach even higher scores in the game.

[h2]Various Smaller Monthly Updates[/h2]

While the two previous updates will take some time to work on, there will be some smaller updates each month that will add various new content, such as new Weapons, Upgrades and various additions. So keep an eye out for future posts.

[h2]Price Increase[/h2]
With this latest addition to the game, Rocket will receive its 1st price increase as part of its Early Access career. On May 20th, 2024 Rocket will increase by $1.00 USD from $4.99 to $5.99.

notes.title: Rocket - One Month Later
notes.notes:
Can you believe it's now been one month since Rocket launched on Steam? I've been very happy with the results so far and wanted to help highlight all the recent additions to the game. Since Rocket launched on February 19th, the game has gotten the following new features and updates:

[list]
[*]New Game Mode called Arcade
[*]New Rocket Weapon & Bomb Weapons (Dual Rockets & Rocket Bomb)
[*]Controller Setup - Which to change which button does what? Now you can!
[*]3 New Steam Achievements. 15 in Total Now!
[*]New Mouse Option for Mouse & Keyboard Users that let you auto-fire your weapon by just holding down the Click Button on your Mouse.
[*]Game now fully supports up to 5 Local Players (Keyboard Player + 4 Controllers) with Drop In/Out Multiplayer anywhere in the game by default.
[*]Menus have been reorganized to be better adjusted
[*]Steam Deck Docked option/mode added to help support when Steam Deck is docked
[*]Various graphical & gameplay changes and improvements
[/list]


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

This is just 1 of many new updates you can expect for the next few months. You will be able to find new game modes, enemies, achievements, ship upgrades and overall features added. But here is what is in the cards right now:

[b]Survive Mode[/b] - This will be similar to Arcade Mode, you start with nothing. Here you are given limited resources & no rocket regen. You will need to survive X amount of time in each level to advance to the next level. Every time you survive a level, you will be given a popup allowing you to choose 1 of 3 Ship Upgrade options. Each new Level takes a little more time and your rockets will be refilled. Don't have to defeat all the enemies or asteroids here, just need to survive and get out of harms way long enough to advance to the next level. This should make for some fun challenging gameplay. Expect to be able to play this new game mode sometime by May or June.

[b]New Ship Upgrades[/b] - You can expect several new fun Ship Upgrades to come to the game in the next few months. These will be sprinkled throughout the various weekly updates to the game. Here are some of the various new upgrades in the works:
[list]
[*]Shield - A protective upgrade that temporarily prevents you from taking damage
[*]Score Multiplier - An upgrade that will increase the Score you get in the game at the cost of having the game be harder.
[*]New Weapon Options - Need I say more?
[/list]
[b]Fun Visual Mode Unlock[/b] - A fun new retro visual look is in the works for the game that can be unlocked. This will make the game look and feel like a classic game from the 70s & 80s.

notes.title: New Weapons & Controller Setup Now Available - Version 1.1.5
notes.notes:
A new update is now here! This update adds 2 new Weapons to the game as well as giving Controller users the ability to remap their Controller config with a new Controller Setup option popup. Want to use the d-pad to fire weapons? Want to switch which button slows down your ship or which fires the Bombs? You can now fully do it!

The first new weapon is called Dual Rockets, which actually once existed in the game during the early Playtest version of the game before being replaced by the Bubble Blaster. This new version fires multiple rockets in dual pairs. As you apply extra Dual Rocket upgrades to your ship, your rockets will multiply and become more powerful.

The second new weapon is a new bomb type called Rocket Bomb. As the name suggested, when this goes off it will shoot off a bunch of rockets all around it. Similar to the other two bomb types, this bomb can be upgraded and will become more powerful sending off more rockets in all directions.

Lastly, with these new weapons comes a new change to the Space Station where you upgrade your ship. You are only allowed 4 weapons and 2 bombs at a time. On the left side of the screen you can change which weapon / bomb you would like equipped. Any weapon that is equipped but not actually upgraded on the right side will be greyed out to help visualize that you won't be able to use it. The same will apply for the right side if a weapon is upgraded but you didn't actually equip it on the left side. So choose wisely which weapons and bombs you would like to use!

notes.notes:
The next big update for Rocket is now available! This update introduces the new Arcade Mode to the game. Unlike the other 3 game modes (Classic, Cadet, Galactic Hero), you will start with no upgrades each new play session. notes.title: Rocket Update - Version 1.0.0d Now Available
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who bought and played Rocket within the last week. I am excited to see how people feel about the game going forward and all that it brings. I have gotten pretty good feedback and spent the week updating the game. Here are all the changes added:

[list]
[*] Game now supports up to 5 local players (Keyboard + 4 Controllers) and shows the 5th player on the HUD
[*] The Space Station Upgrade screen has been slightly modified to show a hint to what Keyboard/Controller button is used for certain weapons as a helpful tip.
[*] Drop In/Out Multiplayer now possible everywhere. Co-Op was always possible, but just in the game modes. This makes it more clear.
[*] Pause Menus have been reorganized and adjusted.
[*] Mazes have been changed up a little bit.
[*] Maze Walls graphics have been changed.
[*] Level progression HUD has been flipped and now fills to 100%
[*] Steam Deck Docked mode now fully supported and fixed.
[/list]

Along with frequent updates to the game, here are the next 2 major updates that are currently in the works:

[b]Arcade Mode[/b] - A more Arcady mode where you start with no upgrades, just your standard main Rocket. As you play you will find Upgrades pop up physically in the game that you can grab to enable & equip. So it's a bit more chaotic and random each time you play. This update should be out by mid March.

[b]Survive Mode[/b] - Similar to Arcade Mode, you start with nothing. Here you are given limited resources & no rocket regen. You will need to survive X amount of time in each level to advance to the next level. Every time you survive a level, you will be given a popup allowing you to choose 1 of 3 Upgrade options. Each new Level takes a little more time and your rockets will be refilled. Don't have to defeat all the enemies or asteroids here, just need to survive and get out of harms way long enough to advance to the next level. This should make for some fun challenging gameplay. The aim for this mode is to release in early to mid Summer.

notes.title: Rocket is Now Available!
notes.notes:
At long last, Rocket is now available for all to play! Rocket is a Bullet Hell, High Stakes Arcade Shooter & Score Chaser. Use your skills to survive the onslaught of asteroids, enemies, black holes and the chaos of rockets and bombs everywhere. Upgrade your ship over time and enjoy the challenge. How high can you score?

I wanted to thank every player who helped give feedback for the Demo over the last year. Your feedback and been very important in turning the game into what it is now. I hope everyone who ends up playing Rocket, will come to like the game!

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

Now that Rocket is available in Early Access, you may be wondering what's next for the game. Well, 1 of the 1st major updates to come will occur in early March with the introduction of a new Game Mode called "Arcade." This will be a bit more arcadey game mode where you are started off with no upgrades and as you destroy asteroids & enemies, new upgrades will appear in front of you for you to take. This will lead to some fun chaotic and randomized gameplay that is sure to become fun.

That is just 1 of several game modes in the works. Along with that, there are other plans for more updates including new ship upgrades as well as Online additions. These are just some of the new additions planned for the game.

notes.title: Rocket - Arcade Bullet Hell Co-Op
notes.notes:
This is an arcade style space shooter game, with heavy influences from the classic Atari game Asteroids as well as the gameplay fun and challenge of a Bullet Hell / Shoot Em Up. As you shoot down asteroids and fire on various enemy ships, you will gain various resources you will need to upgrade your ship with more powerful weapons and various upgrades. Don't forget to avoid space anomalies like black holes and supernovas!

Work toward upgrading your ship each time you play. Each play through builds up resources you can use to power up your ship, allowing you to score higher and explore further. Maximize your ship’s power to rank high on the online leaderboards!

Come watch as we play some Co-Op in Rocket!
